verify ownership, readiness and management CA
deploy OVN/OVS, managed k8gobgp, Multus and node-agent
BGPConfiguration CRD -> k8gobgp reconciliation -> managed gobgpd.
Manager and daemon share one upstream image.
Type-2 reconcilers use local Unix GoBGP gRPC independently of CNI RPCs.

Failure exits instead of the successful ADD above
Full-lifecycle acceptance correlates five capture points and decoded
packets with the initial endpoint identity, VNI, VTEPs and traffic direction.
reject stale identity; absent DEL is idempotent
ADD(new workload UID and attachment identity)
Replacement captures and decoded packets are phase-prefixed and checked
against the new endpoint identity; stale initial attribution must not pass.
delete survivor through CNI; withdraw remote workload;
wait for empty owned routes and endpoint state
guarded ovn-nbctl ls-del of test-owned network
verify foreign LSP / integration devices preserved
collect diagnostics; destroy exact owned topology
owned resources absent; unrelated resources preserved
OVN NBDB -> SBDB binding propagation is asynchronous.
CHECK verifies endpoint identity; it is not a replacement
Rollback depends on the failure point. If local attachment
fails after OVN LSP creation, the current endpoint manager
does not compensate that LSP yet. Current full-lifecycle
evidence injects a missing network namespace before LSP
creation; it does not establish general post-LSP compensation.
This sequence covers the optional Kubernetes CNI application lifecycle.
The full-lifecycle E2E additionally checks repeated ADD/DEL, negative CHECK,
injected pre-LSP ADD rollback, survivor preservation and guarded cleanup. OVN/OVS
endpoint attachment is not the standalone OVSDB-Programmed EVPN dataplane.
Optional Type-2 export/import is a separate CNI integration.
RPC success does not wait for BGP convergence.
This application sequence is not independent Framework
